results.title: ZZ top’s Frank Beard dies at 77: The drummer behind the band’s iconic beat
results.description: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard, who helped power the legendary rock band for six decades, has died at 77. The musician passed away in hospice care at his Texas ranch, with family by his side.
